explanation: With gravity 0 and controller disabled, energy was conserved at 1998.4 J through step 155, then a high-speed elastic (e=1) body-body impact between a large light body and small heavier body injected ~263 J, reaching 2261.85 J above the 2203.24 J limit. Likely cause: impulse plus positional correction at deep/fast contact adds energy beyond exact elastic conservation; making the collision inelastic removes the gain.
